visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish hair, wearing a khaki cropped trench coat and light blue boots, sits on a stone ledge in an urban outdoor area. She gesticulates with her hands while speaking toward the camera. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of her holding a smartphone displaying a calculator app, with digital math formulas and icons overlaid on the screen to emphasize the concept of calculation. (3) The woman stands in front of a modern building, holding up a white Taishin Richart credit card. She wears a white top under her jacket. (4) She is seen walking along a city sidewalk with yellow taxis and traffic in the background, looking cheerful and energetic. (5) The woman walks through a glass doorway into a brightly lit shopping mall (Shin Kong Mitsukoshi). (6) Inside the mall at a cosmetics counter, she interacts with a masked salesperson, holds up her phone to a payment terminal, and completes a transaction. (7) She walks away from the counter carrying multiple shopping bags from Shin Kong Mitsukoshi and other brands, looking triumphant. (8) A screen recording overlay shows the Richart app interface with various reward options like 'Big Brush' and 'Everyday Brush'. (9) The woman poses inside the mall with a small white suitcase, pointing at it to highlight a promotional gift.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An energetic female voice opens with a high-pitched, fast-paced greeting. Upbeat electronic pop background music with a steady synthesized beat starts immediately. Subtle low-frequency traffic hum is audible. (2) A sharp 'pop' sound effect coincides with the appearance of math graphics on screen. The speaker’s intensity increases as she discusses point rewards. (3) A digital 'whoosh' sound marks a transition as the speaker shifts to a friendly, informative tone, introducing the banking product. (4) A short electronic chime triggers a new phase. The background ambience shifts from open street noise to a slightly muffled, reverberant indoor mall atmosphere. (5) A 'ding' sound effect emphasizes a specific percentage figure mentioned by the speaker. (6) A metallic 'click' sound is heard as the woman interacts with her phone and a payment machine, followed by a muffled rustling of shopping bags. (7) A sequence of rapid hard cuts in the audio matches a listed display of app features, each accompanied by a subtle percussive hit. (8) The voice concludes with a warm, encouraging invitation as the background music gradually fades.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Consumer Pain Point -> Product Solution -> Real-world Proof -> Incentive -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the Taishin Bank Richart credit card by demonstrating its specific high-cashback benefits and promotional gifts during department store anniversary sales, targeting young, savvy urban consumers.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator prominently features the physical Taishin Richart card, provides a tutorial on using its app, and lists specific percentage-based rewards associated with the bank.

high_inference.freeDescribe: This video effectively uses high-energy performance and dense informational overlays to make financial products appear trendy and accessible to a younger demographic.
